Reusing food from previous customers!!! Don’t go here
Oct 2025 • Solo
Went to this restaurant yesterday, because it was my first night in Phu Quoc and it’s located near my hostel. The food was amazing, I complimented the staff and told them I would come back. Fast forward to today. I went back for an afternoon snack as promised. Ordered the fresh spring rolls. The girl across from my table was having the same and just finished, but she left one or two rolls on her plate. The staff took that plate went to the kitchen and wanted to put it on the plate they were preparing for me. They saw me seeing them and tried to brush it off by laughing and quickly put the roll away. It felt super awkward. They served the food and the sauce had ants in it. So I took them out. I just should’ve walked away, but had 3 rolls and left the fourth as a statement to let them know I really saw them. Beware of this and skipp this restaurant! There are many other options.

MERIT THE LIGHT DETOUR...
Mar 2025 • Family
We dined at this establishment on the last day... We were staying in a hotel close...
Located in a small street overlooking the main street: the quiet near the multiple shops and hordes of tourists.
Tables scattered in a garden... Family business... Smiling welcome and attentive service... Very varied menu plus proposals of the day... A little waiting, preparation requires...
The dishes are generous, tasty, served at good temperature... 
Value for money: excellent (lower than local competition) with mention for wine (bottle of Dalat three times cheaper!!! To be consumed however with moderation).
So, do not hesitate to leave the main avenue, climb for two to three hundred meters to discover this family restaurant.

We Absolutely Loved It!!
Oct 2024 • Couples
Banana garden is a wonderful family run establishment, everyone is so welcoming and it is such a relaxing experience I would definitely recommend visiting if you are in or around the centre of Phu quoc.

Me and my partner were struggling to find any place to eat for our first few days here with disappointing experiences in the night market and in the beach bars. After a little bit of research I was able to find the banana garden on trip advisor with great reviews and honestly well deserved. I am not ashamed to mention that I returned for dinner every evening as the food never disappointed and the prices are much more reasonable for travellers than many of the other surrounding restaurants. 

The menu has a great range but not so much as the quality of food suffers and is located next to a beautiful banana tree garden hence the name. I only wish I had taken the time to take pictures of the food but it wasn’t around long enough for any pictures.
